names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 iunie, which names the four youths «Ipatie, Paul, Dionisie și Claudie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Λουκιλλιανός, Παύλη και τα νήπια Κλαύδιος, Υπάτιος, Παύλος και Διονύσιος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 3. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученици Лукилијан и с њим: Клавдије, Ипатије, Павле, Дионисије, и девица Паула“. Свети is not a rank, мученици is the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types`, and the heading carries no see, no house and no epithet, so the form is the bare personal name the heading itself prints. `foldchk.py` returns three holders already — `dionysius-companion-of-quadratus`, `dionysius-companion-of-socrates`, `dionysius-of-lampsacus` — so this is the fourth on the string, deliberate on the same reading.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 619 gives it, «Дионисий Византийский, мч.», with the rank word taken off; the day line declines the forename and prints no epithet, so «Византийский» is read off the name page. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'византиискии дионисии' has no other holder, where a bare forename would meet the corpus's many Dionysius folders.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Лукиллиана , Клавдия , Ипатия , Павла , Дионисия и мц. Павлы девы (ок. 270-275).»

attestations.note: The day's first entry of six, «Мчч. Лукиллиана , Клавдия , Ипатия , Павла , Дионисия и мц. Павлы девы (ок. 270-275).», one line naming SIX people and giving them one bracket; six `name:` links stand under it, one for each, and all six already had folders in this corpus, kept on this same menologion day by the Romanian, Greek and Serbian calendars. The year the line gives the company, «(ок. 270-275)», is the very interval all six folders already hold for the death, so nothing of `dates` was touched. `life1219`, which all six name links point at, was NOT read: the identification rests on the day, on the six names in the calendar's own order, on the year, and on the Byzantium the six name pages give each of them, and the folders' lives already carry the passion from the other three calendars. The day page prints four hymns, two for the tsarevich Dimitri and two for the Yug icon, and none under any of these six names. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Luchilian şi cei împreună cu el patru tineri: Ipatie, Paul, Dionisie și Claudie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Λουκιλλιανός, Παύλη και τα νήπια Κλαύδιος, Υπάτιος, Παύλος και Διονύσιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and it does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. One page carries the whole company, with a head line for each of the six and the year «(; - 270)» against every one of them, and the story is the same story doxologia told: the aged pagan priest of Nicomedia who was converted, was denounced to the count, was thrown into a fire that rain put out, was sent to Byzantium and crucified; the four children he found already in prison, who were beheaded; and the virgin who buried him and was beheaded after him. It is plainly the same six. Nicomedia and Byzantium are named and `locations` is left out. Two apolytikia are taken and both stand in all six folders: the first names Lucillian, Paula and the four children together, and the second is the common of martyrs printed under the company's name. He is the last named of the four whom the page calls νήπια, infants; its verse on them says that the sword, of children whose number is twice two, makes sons of God the Father.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.06.2026 (3. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Лукилијан и с њим: Клавдије, Ипатије, Павле, Дионисије, и девица Паула“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. AN ENUMERATED COMPANY OF SIX AND THE CORPUS HOLDS ALL SIX. The heading names five and adds „и девица Паула“, so six names, and all six stood on the day list for the menologion 3/6 — `lucillian`, `claudius-companion-of-lucillian`, `hypatius-companion-of-lucillian`, `paul-companion-of-lucillian`, `dionysius-companion-of-lucillian`, `paula-companion-of-lucillian`. Second day in a row the day list found a whole company unaided; `sr-namesweep.mjs` scores only a heading’s first name and was no use. A DEATH WIDENED BY FIVE YEARS ON ALL SIX, AND THE BOOK PRINTS THE BRACKET ITSELF. The six folders held `death` 270 flat, off saint.gr’s «(; - 270)» and its sentence that Lucillian lived in the years of Aurelian, in 270; doxologia printed no year. This book closes: „Мучеништво њихово догодило се у време цара Аврелијана, између 270-275. године“. Keeping the flat 270 would NARROW the bracket this book prints, so `death` becomes 270 to 275, display «270–275» in the dash form. THE REIGN IS NOT THE SOURCE AND THAT DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE OF IT: this wave has four times refused a reign used to derive a year, and refuses one here too — but the book does not leave the reign to be converted, it prints the two years itself, which is the same ground `erasmus-10-may` stands on for its «249–251». `basis` stays `traditional` on all six. TWENTY NEW `related` ROWS, TEN PAIRS, ALL RECIPROCAL. `lucillian` already related to all five; THE FIVE RELATED ONLY TO HIM AND NOT TO EACH OTHER, so a reader could not walk from Claudius to Hypatius although the two were in one prison and under one sword. The heading enumerates all six and the body narrates ONE martyrdom for all six, which is the test that owes a row, so each of the five gains the other four. `lucillian` gains nothing, having them already. `types` UNTOUCHED ON ALL SIX. Свети мученици is the `martyr` all six carry and девица the `virgin` Paula carries; nothing in the heading grades anyone higher. No `locations` — Nicomedia and Byzantium are in both earlier accounts and the folders have stayed unplaced. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. `foldchk.py` returns three holders already — `dionysius-companion-of-quadratus`, `dionysius-companion-of-socrates`, `dionysius-of-lampsacus` — so this is the fourth on the string, deliberate on the same reading.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Luchilian; the text is the common of several martyrs, printed for him and those with him.

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength they overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἄστρον φαεινόν, ἐκ νυκτὸς τῆς ἀπάτης, ὦ Λουκιλλιανέ, εὐσεβῶς ἀναλάμψας νομίμως ἠγώνισαι καὶ τὸν δόλιον ἔκτεινας· ὅθεν πρέσβευε σὺν τῇ θεόφρονι Παύλῃ καὶ τοῖς τέσσαρσι παισὶ Χριστῷ, ἀθλοφόρε, ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Χορός Ἀγγελικός, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Λουκιλλιανός, Παύλη και τα νήπια Κλαύδιος, Υπάτιος, Παύλος και Διονύσιος». It is the company's own hymn: it names Lucillian, Paula and the four children together, which is why it stands in each of the six folders.

english.text: Shining out in piety like a bright star from the night of deceit, O Lucillian, you contended lawfully and slew the deceiver; and so, with the godly-minded Paula and the four children, intercede with Christ, O prize-winner, for our souls.

hymns.text: Τοὺς μάρτυρας Χριστοῦ, ἱκετεύσωμεν πάντες, αὐτοὶ γὰρ τὴν ἡμῶν, σωτηρίαν αἰτοῦνται, καὶ πόθῳ προσέλθωμεν, πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ πίστεως, οὖτοι βρύουσι τῶν ἰαμάτων τὴν χάριν, οὖτοι φάλαγγας, ἀποσοβοῦσι δαιμόνων, ὡς φύλακες τῆς πίστεως.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Άγιος Λουκιλλιανός, Παύλη και τα νήπια Κλαύδιος, Υπάτιος, Παύλος και Διονύσιος». It names no saint and is the common of martyrs; printed under this company's name it is their service, and it is copied whole, as the brief's ruling on a common requires.

english.text: Let us all entreat the martyrs of Christ, for they themselves ask for our salvation; and let us come to them with longing and with faith. They pour out the grace of healings, they drive off the phalanxes of demons, as guards of the faith.

death.note: saint.gr's head line for each of the six reads «(; - 270)» and its life says Lucillian lived in the years of the emperor Aurelian, in 270. doxologia.ro's life, which this folder was built from, printed no year. The Охридски пролог for 3. јун ст. ст. prints the bracket itself: „Мучеништво њихово догодило се у време цара Аврелијана, између 270-275. године“. The interval is widened to that bracket, because holding the flat 270 would narrow a range this book states in its own words; the two years are the book's and were not derived from the reign (5 October 2026).
